scripts.name: a short radio script
scripts.raw:
ANNA: Is anyone there? (She knocks.)

BEN: Only me.

SOUND: A door.

MUSIC: Low.

ACT TWO

ANNA: [inside] Then who is singing?

BEN: The pipes.

And they went on singing.
scripts.title: The Pipes
